create_Model: create a fully connected neural network Model with configurable hidden layer sizes and batch normalization
create_ModelConv: create a convolutional neural network ModelConv with configurable conv layers and a final linear output layer
prune_network: prune a Model or ModelConv network by computing L1 norms and masking inactive input neurons per layer
init_w_layer: initialize a linear or conv layer weight matrix using separate value choices and uniform bias
normalize_layer: normalize each output row of a layer weight matrix by its L2 norm and scale the bias accordingly
